examples.arabic: كان الطريق الى مكتبه مزدحما كالعادة لكنه اعتاد على ذلك
examples.english: The road to his office was crowded as usual, but he was used to it.
examples.transliteration: Kana al-tareeq ila maktabihi muzdahiman kal-'adah, lakinahu i'tada 'ala thalik.

examples.arabic: اقول له من فضلك اين الطريق الى المكتبة
examples.english: I say to him, 'Please, where is the road to the library?'
examples.transliteration: Aqul lahu: min fadlika, ayna al-tariq ila al-maktabah?
